title: NMR console: the analog front end and its housing
blurb: Work in progress. The analog side of the class board - thirteen nets from the link header out to the SMA field and the TX coil terminal - routed with no vias at all, so no analog signal changes reference plane. Around it a housing rebuilt from my own spec: no vents, every connector and terminal pole named in white, and a cover split in two so every part prints without supports.
